result.reason: The operative language reaches the playbook position: Client retains its IP and Customer Data without joint ownership; deliverables and work product created specifically for Client are assigned to Client; and TrueLink retains pre-existing or independently developed IP while granting a perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free licence for embedded IP, including modification and sublicensing rights. It appropriately preserves TrueLink’s ownership of the Interface and the existing Credit Data licence. The change is targeted and commercially consistent. Drafting is generally professional, though “in which TrueLink hereby grants” is awkward and would be clearer as “with respect to which,” and the inherited definition contains the apparent typo “any or its intellectual property.”
